title: 未命名草稿0089未命名草稿088
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰微微一笑：“自然要去。如此上古秘境，机缘遍地，错过未免可惜。”
说罢，他对着诸位长老与南宫鸿微微拱手，身形一动，化作一道青衫流光，径直朝着秘境之门掠去，瞬间便踏入云雾之中，消失不见。
南宫鸿望着叶辰离去的背影，眸中闪过一丝复杂难明的神色，有忌惮，有不满，也有一丝无奈。此子太过锋芒毕露，实力强悍，心智深沉，绝非池中之物，留在朱雀域，日后必定会成为南宫世家的心腹大患。
一旁的南宫世家长老低声道：“家主，就这样让他进入秘境？烈儿受了这般屈辱，难道就这么算了？不如暗中安排族中高手，进入秘境伺机而动，除掉此人，永绝后患。”
南宫鸿眼神一沉，沉吟片刻，缓缓摇头：“不可。此刻四大仙宗长老都在此处，若是我们贸然派人在秘境截杀李寻道，一旦败露，南宫世家将会彻底失去各大势力的信任，得不偿失。再者，此子修为高深，心智狡诈，寻常高手未必能奈何得了他，反而会折损我方人手。”
他顿了顿，眸中闪过一丝冷厉：“不必急于一时，秘境之内危机四伏，还有其他世家天骄对他心怀不满，说不定不用我们动手，他便会折在秘境之中。即便他能安然出来，往后有的是机会对付他。先静观其变，暂且隐忍。”
长老闻言，顿时了然，微微躬身：“家主思虑周全，是老夫莽撞了。”
与此同时，秘境之中。
叶辰踏入秘境之门后，只觉得眼前光影变幻，天旋地转，片刻之后，双脚便落在了一片苍茫的古老林海之中。
参天古木高耸入云，枝干交错，遮天蔽日，林间云雾缭绕，灵气浓郁得几乎化为实质，吸入肺中，顿时浑身经脉舒畅，灵力都不由自主地缓缓运转起来。
四周古木苍劲，藤蔓缠绕，地面长满了奇花异草，时不时有珍稀的灵兽在林间穿梭，发出低沉的嘶吼，空气中弥漫着草木与灵兽的气息。
叶辰环顾四周，神识悄然铺开，瞬间笼罩方圆千里之地。
秘境之内地域辽阔，山川连绵，林海无边，分布着无数灵脉宝地、洞府遗迹，同时也潜藏着不少凶险的高阶凶兽、天然杀阵，稍不留意，便有可能陨落在此。
叶辰看着那压塌混沌的黑暗巨手，看着身后一个个剑心动摇的追随者，眸中赤色剑光，第一次变得无比炽盛！
他没有后退，没有躲闪，而是一步踏出，独自挡在万千剑修身前。
“上古先辈，以身为剑，阻黑暗万古。”
“今日，我叶辰，承上古剑祖意志，继诸天剑道传承，岂会让悲剧重演。”
他缓缓抬起右手，这一次，他没有动用心剑，没有动用剑域，而是将整个诸天万界，亿万剑修的信仰之力，尽数凝聚于指尖！
残剑界内，重铸道基的残剑老人，正引导剑修重归正道，突然抬头望向混沌方向，恭敬叩首，周身正道剑意冲天而起；
心剑界中，无剑老人带领万千修士，口诵剑心诀，亿万道心剑之力，跨越位面，汇聚而来；

霸剑界、幽剑界、乱剑星域……但凡被叶辰指引过正道的剑修，无论身在何方，尽数感受到那股召唤，齐齐跪拜，将自身最纯粹的剑心之力，毫无保留地奉献给他们心中唯一的剑祖！
刹那间，叶辰指尖，凝聚了诸天万界，亿万剑修的正道剑心！
这不是杀伐之力，不是毁灭之力，而是传承之力、守护之力、希望之力！
“你要灭剑，我便铸剑。”
“你要断传承，我便续万古。”
剑镇诸天，道无止境。
万道归心，剑祖永恒。
“看来这些异族也是刚到不久，还没来得及深入遗迹。”鲁明说道。
半个时辰后，众人的灵力都恢复得差不多了，叶辰起身道：“走吧，我们继续深入遗迹，争取尽快找到核心区域。”
众人起身，朝着遗迹深处走去。经过刚才的激战，大家的警惕性更高了，每一步都走得小心翼翼。周围的建筑越来越密集，也越来越完整，虽然依旧残破，但能看出上古时期这里曾经是一座繁华的城池。街道两旁的建筑上刻满了精美的符文和图案，虽然大多已经模糊，但依旧能感受到上古时期的文明气息。
突然，前方出现了一座巨大的石门，石门高约十丈，宽约五丈，通体由一种不知名的黑色岩石打造而成，上面刻着复杂的上古符文，符文中央镶嵌着一颗巨大的黑色晶石，散发着微弱的能量波动。石门紧闭，显然是通往遗迹核心区域的入口。
“这应该就是遗迹的主门了，上面的符文看起来像是一种封印禁制。”乔圆圆走到石门前，仔细观察着上面的符文，眉头微蹙，“这是三阶禁制，而且是上古时期的封印符文，破解起来有些难度。”
content_en:
Ye Chen smiled slightly: "Of course I want to go. Such an ancient secret place is full of opportunities. It would be a pity to miss it."
After saying that, he slightly cupped his hands to the elders and Nangong Hong, and with a movement of his body, he turned into a stream of green light and flew straight towards the door of the secret realm. In an instant, he stepped into the clouds and disappeared.
Nangong Hong looked at Ye Chen's leaving back, a complicated and difficult-to-understand expression flashed in his eyes, including fear, dissatisfaction, and a hint of helplessness. This son is too sharp-edged, powerful, and deep-minded. He is definitely not a thing in the pond. If he stays in the Suzaku Territory, he will definitely become a serious problem for the Nangong family in the future.
The elder of the Nangong family on the side said in a low voice: "Master, are you letting him enter the secret realm like this? Lie'er has suffered such humiliation, can you just let it go? Why not secretly arrange for the masters of the clan to enter the secret realm and wait for an opportunity to get rid of this person and avoid future troubles forever."
Nangong Hong's eyes darkened, he pondered for a moment, and then slowly shook his head: "No. The four elders of the Immortal Sect are all here at the moment. If we rashly send people to intercept and kill Li Xundao in the secret realm, once it is revealed, the Nangong family will completely lose the trust of all the major forces, and the loss will outweigh the gain. Furthermore, this son has a high level of cultivation and a cunning mind. Ordinary experts may not be able to defeat him, but will instead damage our manpower."
He paused, and a hint of coldness flashed in his eyes: "There is no need to rush, the secret realm is full of dangers, and there are other talented families who are dissatisfied with him. Maybe he will be trapped in the secret realm without us taking action. Even if he can come out safely, there will be many opportunities to deal with him in the future. Let's wait and see what happens, and bear it for now."
When the elder heard the words, he suddenly understood and bowed slightly: "The master of the house is thoughtful, but I am reckless."
At the same time, in the secret realm.
After Ye Chen stepped into the door of the secret realm, he felt the light and shadow changing in front of his eyes, and the world was spinning. After a moment, his feet landed in a vast ancient forest.
The towering ancient trees tower into the clouds, their branches are intertwined, blocking out the sky and the sun. The forest is filled with clouds and mist. The spiritual energy is so rich that it almost turns into substance. When you inhale it into your lungs, your meridians all over your body will feel relaxed, and your spiritual energy will start to slowly circulate involuntarily.
Surrounded by vigorous ancient trees and tangled vines, the ground is covered with exotic flowers and grasses. From time to time, rare spiritual beasts shuttle through the forest, making low roars, and the air is filled with the scent of vegetation and spiritual beasts.
Ye Chen looked around, and his spiritual consciousness quietly spread out, covering a thousand miles around in an instant.
The secret realm is vast, with rolling mountains and rivers, and boundless forests. It is dotted with countless spiritual treasures and cave ruins. It also lurks many dangerous high-level beasts and natural killing arrays. If you don't pay attention, you may fall here.
Ye Chen looked at the giant dark hand that crushed the chaos, and at the followers behind him whose swords were wavering, the red sword light in his eyes became extremely blazing for the first time!
He did not retreat or dodge, but took one step forward, standing alone in front of thousands of sword cultivators.
"The ancient ancestors used their bodies as swords to block the darkness for eternity."
"Today, I, Ye Chen, have inherited the will of the ancient sword ancestors and inherited the swordsmanship of the heavens. How can I let the tragedy happen again?"
He slowly raised his right hand. This time, he did not use the Heart Sword or the Sword Domain. Instead, he condensed the power of faith of hundreds of millions of sword cultivators in the entire universe into his fingertips!
In the Broken Sword Realm, Old Broken Sword, who was recasting the Taoist foundation, was guiding the sword cultivators back to the right path. He suddenly raised his head and looked in the direction of chaos, kowtowed respectfully, and the sword intent of the right path soared into the sky around him;
In the Heart Sword Realm, Old Man Wu Jian led thousands of monks to recite the Sword Heart Art, and the power of billions of Heart Swords gathered across planes;
The Overlord Sword Realm, the Nether Sword Realm, the Chaos Sword Star Realm... all the sword cultivators who were guided by Ye Chen to the right path, no matter where they were, felt the call, knelt down and dedicated their purest sword heart power to the only sword ancestor in their hearts without reservation!
In an instant, Ye Chen's fingertips condensed the righteous sword hearts of hundreds of millions of sword cultivators from all over the world!
This is not the power of killing or destroyingThe power of destruction, but the power of inheritance, protection, and hope!
"If you want to destroy the sword, I will forge it."
"If you want to end the inheritance, I will continue it forever."
The sword rules the heavens, and the way has no end.
All paths return to the heart, and the sword ancestor is eternal.
"It seems that these alien races have just arrived and haven't had time to go deep into the ruins yet," Lu Ming said.
Half an hour later, everyone's spiritual power was almost restored. Ye Chen stood up and said: "Let's go, let's continue to go deep into the ruins and try to find the core area as soon as possible."
Everyone stood up and walked towards the depths of the ruins. After the fierce battle just now, everyone is more vigilant and takes every step carefully. The surrounding buildings are becoming more and more dense and complete. Although it is still dilapidated, it can be seen that this place was once a prosperous city in ancient times. The buildings on both sides of the street are covered with exquisite runes and patterns. Although most of them are blurred, you can still feel the atmosphere of ancient civilization.
Suddenly, a huge stone door appeared in front of it. The stone door was about ten feet high and five feet wide. It was made of an unknown black rock and was engraved with complex ancient runes. In the center of the runes was a huge black crystal inlaid, exuding weak energy fluctuations. The stone door is closed, obviously the entrance to the core area of ​​the ruins.
"This should be the main gate of the ruins. The runes on it look like a sealing restriction." Qiao Yuanyuan walked to the stone door and carefully observed the runes on it, frowning slightly. "This is a third-level restriction, and it is a sealing rune from ancient times. It is a bit difficult to crack."
